title: Kusanagi Nene — Dazzling Dream Stage〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: On a certain holiday
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Morning.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Good morning, Nene! Rui!
Let's give it our best during practice today☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: By the way, Nene, did you see the news this morning?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The news? Oh, about Ms. Kazamatsuri?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hey, I saw that too☆
I had a feeling that you'd be really happy about it♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. And you're right to say that, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We saw what had happened on our way over here. It's been so long since I'd last seen Nene become so excited about something.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
O-Of course I'm excited...
I mean, it's really big news.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Indeed it is! It's not every day that you're cast in a Broadway musical!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, exactly...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I even recorded her press conference without a second thought.)

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: <It's always been a dream of mine to perform not just at the West End, but on a Broadway stage as well.>

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: <I've also had the honor of seeing many different productions of this work since becoming a stage actress...>

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: <As such, I've gone through it countless times in my head in terms of how I'd play this particular role.>

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: <And I promise to do everything in my power to make sure our guests truly enjoy what they see.>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Her character has to remember a lot of long lines and monologues, so it won't be easy. At the same time, she's essentially in a supporting role opposite the lead.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Not only that, she seemed really calm and collected throughout that interview.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (She's such an amazing person.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hey, Nene♪
What do you think Broadway's like?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? What it's like...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well, it's a very busy thoroughfare in New York City that runs right through Times Square and one of the theatrical capitals of the world.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That along with the West End in London are said to be the best places for musical theatre.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
The best...?!
Th-That's so cool!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And there are more theatres there than you can count! Some are even lined up next to each other one after another!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: On top of that, most of them have musicals running every single day. It'd take someone at least a month to go around to all of them.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
E-Every single day?!
You can see that many shows?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Some theatres also just focus on famous, individual works.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Even though it's the same play, it's supposed to be fun to compare and contrast different writing, directing and acting styles.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Whoa! That sound like fun☆

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Also, because these theatres specialize in just one play, their interiors are made to look just like what it describes. It's supposed to be quite impressive.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You'll walk in thinking that it's just a theatre and suddenly find yourself standing somewhere completely different...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's also interesting how the dimensions of the stage, the detailed backgrounds and even the props they use are all designed to immerse you into this world...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, I really want to go see a Broadway production in person someday.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh? Just seeing is enough for you, Nene?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Broadway's the pinnacle of theatre! Why not strive to perform on stage?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I am Tsukasa Tenma! Future star of the showbiz world!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I am destined to perform in a Broadway production! Of course, as the lead! Hah hah hah hah!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Perform in a Broadway production...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Anything you can do, I can do just as well, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Whoa! You two sounded so cool just now!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehehe.
Nene's Room

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Broadway, huh...?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (That's the dream if you're someone performing in musicals...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Oh, I think I'll watch Ms. Kazamatsuri's interview again.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Turn the TV on and...
Oh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe. She even made the evening news.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: <And I promise to do everything in my power to make sure our guests truly enjoy what they see.>

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: <Is there anyone I'd like to thank or mention...?>

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: <That would have to be everybody from the troupe I started out in!>

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: <I hope you're all watching! I promise to do my best!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Her old troupe...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Oh, that's right. The first troupe she joined had less than ten people in it.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (And she had to walk away from them to pursue her dream of performing in shows around the world...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hm? Did my phone just flash?
bgm_area00004
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hmm... I'm not seeing Miku or the others...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
But my phone definitely flashed.
That usually means they're up to something.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Hey, it did it again...
Seriously, what's going on...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(A ball...?
Am I supposed to pick this up?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Or is this some kind of prank?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Fine, I'll play along...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Alright, there...
I picked you up...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? Wh-What the?! So bright...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Ugh...!
I knew it. It's one of Rui's...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wh-Where am I...?!
